import warnings; warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
t=np.asarray(t,float); P=np.asarray(P,float); y=np.asarray(dP_dt,float)
def basis(c):
    return np.c_[P**2, np.log(1+c[0]*P)*t, np.tanh(c[1]*t)]
def r(c):
    A=basis(c); a,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,y,rcond=None)
    return y-A@a
